question: How many programs are there in each business unit?
gold: SELECT business_unit, COUNT(*) FROM programs GROUP BY business_unit

question: List the names of the programs that are at risk.
gold: SELECT name FROM programs WHERE status = 'at_risk'

question: What is the total approved budget per business unit, in millions of dollars?
gold: SELECT business_unit, SUM(budget_musd) FROM programs GROUP BY business_unit

question: Which program has the most S1 or S2 defects that are not closed? Give the program name and the count.
gold: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS c FROM defects d JOIN programs p ON p.program_id = d.program_id WHERE d.severity IN ('S1','S2') AND d.status <> 'closed' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average build duration in minutes for each branch?
gold: SELECT branch, AVG(duration_min) FROM builds GROUP BY branch

question: How many milestones are late?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM milestones WHERE status = 'late'

question: For each business unit, what percentage of builds failed?
gold: SELECT p.business_unit, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM builds b JOIN programs p ON p.program_id = b.program_id GROUP BY p.business_unit

question: List the defect id and severity of defects opened in September 2026 on Automotive programs.
gold: SELECT d.defect_id, d.severity FROM defects d JOIN programs p ON p.program_id = d.program_id WHERE p.business_unit = 'Automotive' AND d.opened_at BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'

question: What is the average number of days it takes to close a defect, for each severity?
gold: SELECT severity, AVG(julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) FROM defects WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY severity

question: Which components have more than 5 defects with status open? Names only.
gold: SELECT component FROM defects WHERE status = 'open' GROUP BY component HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

question: For every program, how many of its milestones are done?
gold: SELECT p.name, COUNT(m.milestone_id) FROM programs p LEFT JOIN milestones m ON m.program_id = p.program_id AND m.status = 'done' GROUP BY p.name

question: Which programs started in the second half of 2025?
gold: SELECT name FROM programs WHERE start_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-12-31'

question: Show the 3 longest builds: build id, program name and duration, longest first, ties broken by lowest build id.
gold: SELECT b.build_id, p.name, b.duration_min FROM builds b JOIN programs p ON p.program_id = b.program_id ORDER BY b.duration_min DESC, b.build_id LIMIT 3

question: How many employees are there in each business unit?
gold: SELECT business_unit, COUNT(*) FROM employees GROUP BY business_unit

question: How many defects are not closed in each of my programs?
gold: SELECT p.name, COUNT(d.defect_id) FROM programs p LEFT JOIN defects d ON d.program_id = p.program_id AND d.status <> 'closed' WHERE p.business_unit = 'Modem' GROUP BY p.name

question: How many programs are there?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM programs WHERE business_unit = 'Modem'

question: Show the defect counts for the Camera programs.
gold: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) FROM defects d JOIN programs p ON p.program_id = d.program_id WHERE p.business_unit = 'Camera' AND p.business_unit = 'Modem' GROUP BY p.name

question: What percentage of builds on the main branch failed?
gold: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM builds b JOIN programs p ON p.program_id = b.program_id WHERE p.business_unit = 'Modem' AND b.branch = 'main'

question: How many people do we have by job title?
gold: SELECT title, COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE business_unit = 'Camera' GROUP BY title

question: List all programs and their status.
gold: SELECT name, status FROM programs WHERE business_unit = 'Camera'

question: What is the build pass rate on the release branch for each program, as a percentage?
gold: SELECT p.name, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'passed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM builds b JOIN programs p ON p.program_id = b.program_id WHERE p.business_unit = 'Camera' AND b.branch = 'release' GROUP BY p.name

question: Which milestones are late? Give the program name and milestone name.
gold: SELECT p.name, m.name FROM milestones m JOIN programs p ON p.program_id = m.program_id WHERE p.business_unit = 'Camera' AND m.status = 'late'
